editor_note: Nothing on this page would mislead a learner, but several things need fixing. Entry [25] (the "Postselection with bit-flip checks" card) was never translated: title, description and link text are all still English, and entry [27]'s link text is also still "Browse documentation". Key terms are rendered inconsistently. Noise is ضوضاء in most places but ضجيج in [19]. Observable is مراقِب in some entries and مرصود in [19], and operator is مؤثرات in some entries but عوامل in [7]. The link text also switches between تصفّح التوثيق and تصفح الوثائق. "Multi-product formulas" became صيغ متعددة المنتجات, where المنتجات means commercial products rather than mathematical products (جداءات). In [16], "probabilistic" is attached to sampling instead of to error cancellation.

editor_note: In the rewritten entry 11, the `job.result()` row renders "blocking call until complete" as "استدعاء محظور حتى الانتهاء". محظور means "forbidden/prohibited", so the row now says the call is not allowed until the job completes. The real meaning is the opposite: you can call it at any time, and it blocks (waits) until the result is ready. This teaches a false concept of blocking, so the entry needs something like "استدعاء حاجب ينتظر حتى الانتهاء" or "يوقف التنفيذ حتى اكتمال المهمة". Separately, and only a minor point, the `wait_for_final_state()` row's "انتظر حتى..." drops the explicit blocking sense of "Block until"; "يوقف التنفيذ حتى تصل المهمة إلى حالة نهائية" would keep the two rows parallel.

examples.source: | `job.result()` | Retrieve job results (blocking call until complete) |
examples.translation: | `job.result()` | استرجع نتائج المهمة (استدعاء محظور حتى الانتهاء) |
examples.suggested: | `job.result()` | استرجع نتائج المهمة (استدعاء حاجب ينتظر حتى اكتمال المهمة) |
examples.why: محظور means 'forbidden', so the row tells the learner they may not call result() before the job completes. In fact the call is allowed and simply blocks until the job finishes. The rendering asserts a false constraint.

examples.source: | `job.wait_for_final_state()` | Block until the job reaches a terminal state |
examples.translation: | `job.wait_for_final_state()` | انتظر حتى تصل المهمة إلى حالة نهائية |
examples.suggested: | `job.wait_for_final_state()` | يوقف التنفيذ حتى تصل المهمة إلى حالة نهائية |
examples.why: 'Block' is a specific programming concept (execution is halted). 'انتظر' is acceptable but vaguer, and it doesn't match how the result() row should describe blocking. Minor.

Both rewritten entries keep the English meaning. Entry 32 renders "shallower" correctly as "أقل عمقًا". editor_note: Entry 76 keeps the English meaning: it asks which computational-basis superposition gives a QFT with peaks on every odd number, and it matches the answer in entry 77. There is one grammar error. In "تحويلاً فورييه كمياً", the head of the construct phrase "تحويل فورييه" has tanween (nunation), which Arabic grammar does not allow. It reads like a calque, and a native editor would rephrase it, for example as "يعطي تحويلُ فورييه الكمي له قممًا". "رقم ثنائي" (binary digit) for "binary number" is weaker than "عدد ثنائي", but entry 77 uses the same wording, so it is consistent.

editor_note: The three entries are faithful and use standard Arabic: Modules→الوحدات, Computer Science→علوم الحاسوب, Quantum Mechanics→ميكانيكا الكم, and the links and anchors are unchanged.

Both rewritten entries are faithful. In [28], "بصرف النظر عن أي الخيارين صحيح" and "نتائج مختلفة للخيارَين" keep the same-versus-different contrast, and in [32], spin-1 becomes "بلف مغزلي 1" with aligned spins rendered "متوازيين، لا متعاكسين", which matches the neighbouring answer entry [31] that also uses لف.

The meaning holds throughout, including the parts that are easy to get wrong: little-endian ordering, the CNOT and Toffoli tables and the deliberately false True/False items such as "2N" in [232]. No sentence would mislead a learner, but some terms are inconsistent and a few sentences read stiffly. "Measurement collapses the state" is rendered as "تُطيح بـ" everywhere ([159], [160], [186], [220], [231]); that is an odd verb, and the usual physics term is "انهيار"/"تنهار". "Computational basis" is split between "القاعدة الحسابية" ([67], [93]) and "الأساس الحسابي" ([125], [216]), Hadamard appears as both "هادامار" and "Hadamard", and "decompose" as both "تحليل" and "تفكيك". A few calques also need fixing: "وباحتمالية كم" in [195], the missing verb before `decompose()` in [141], and the singular "الكيوبت المنطقي… كيوبت فيزيائي" in [190], where the English has plural qubits.

editor_note: Entry 9 is faithful and reads naturally. "Quantization of measured spin components" is rendered as تكميم مكونات السبين المقاسة, and "Play with repeated measurements" as جرّب القياسات المتكررة, which fits the informal register. It also spells the name ستيرن-غيرلاخ, the same way as the page title.

Entry [36] translates "joint quasiprobability distribution" as "التوزيع الاحتمالي شبه الكمومي المشترك", which means a "quasi-quantum probability distribution". That adds a "quantum" qualifier the source does not have and loses the quasiprobability concept, which is central to circuit cutting because the coefficients can be negative, so it teaches a false idea. It should be "توزيع شبه الاحتمالية المشترك". There are also minor stiff spots. The title [0] says "ثنائية Qubit" where "ثنائية الكيوبت" is expected, and the transpile calque "نقل ... عبر Transpiler" in [8]/[40] reads unnaturally. The rest is faithful, including the Move/reset/SWAP explanation and the entanglement caveat in [20].

editor_note: Nothing in this translation would mislead a learner, but three terms in the addon table (entry [6]) need tightening. "Approximate Quantum Compilation" is rendered as التحويل الكمومي التقريبي. التحويل means "conversion", not "compilation"; the usual term is التصريف, or الترجمة البرمجية. examples.translation: عمق البوابات الثنائية الكيوبت، وعدد البوابات، ووقت الترجمة
examples.suggested: عمق البوابات ثنائية البت الكمومي، وعدد البوابات، ووقت التحويل البرمجي
examples.why: This is the only place that uses 'كيوبت' and 'الترجمة'. The rest of the file uses 'بت كمومي' and 'التحويل البرمجي'.

examples.source: Small-scale simulator example
examples.translation: مثال على محاكي صغير الحجم
examples.suggested: مثال صغير النطاق على المحاكي
examples.why: The Arabic makes the simulator small, but in the source 'small-scale' describes the example.

editor_note: The page's main conclusion is mistranslated in three places. "Scaling" is rendered as قياس ("measurement") in [96], [99] and [101], and this is a page about mid-circuit measurements. So [96] says the crossover comes from "differences in depth measurement" when the source says different depth scaling. [99] says "depth captures the logical measurement of two-qubit ops", right next to the real measurement count. [101] turns "constant-depth scaling" into "constant measurement of depth". Smaller problems: [80]–[81] switch from the file's دوائر/موحدة/تحويل/الخلفية to دارات/أحادية/التصريف/Backend. [95] renders decoherence as التراجع الكمي (a non-standard term) and has a gender error (يبدأ الدائرة). [44] renders "Pauli byproducts" as مقادير جانبية ("side quantities"), which is awkward.

examples.source: This is a direct result of the different scaling: the depth of the unitary circuit grows linearly...
examples.translation: يعكس ذلك مباشرةً الفروق في قياس العمق
examples.suggested: يعكس ذلك مباشرةً اختلاف سلوك التدرّج (القابلية للتوسع): ينمو عمق الدائرة الموحدة خطيًا...
examples.why: قياس means 'measurement'. The sentence now says the crossover comes from how depth is measured, not from how depth grows with distance. That misleads the learner on the page's key conclusion.

examples.source: Depth captures the logical scaling of two-qubit operations, while the measurement count reflects the additional overhead
examples.translation: يلتقط العمق القياس المنطقي للعمليات ثنائية الكيوبت، بينما يعكس عدد القياسات الحمل الإضافي
examples.suggested: يعكس العمق كيفية تزايد العمليات ثنائية الكيوبت منطقيًا مع المسافة، بينما يعكس عدد القياسات الحمل الإضافي
examples.why: 'Scaling' becomes 'measurement' in the same sentence as the actual measurement count, so the two concepts get mixed up.

examples.source: we expect the constant-depth and constant-measurement scaling of dynamic circuits to yield clear fidelity and runtime advantages
examples.translation: نتوقع أن يُحقق القياس الثابت للعمق وعدد القياسات الثابت للدوائر الديناميكية مزايا واضحة
examples.suggested: نتوقع أن يُحقق ثبات العمق وثبات عدد القياسات في الدوائر الديناميكية مع ازدياد المسافة مزايا واضحة
examples.why: The scaling claim (constant as distance grows) becomes 'constant measurement of depth', which does not say the same thing.

examples.source: both dynamic and unitary circuits ... ready for transpilation. We first need to select a backend device.
examples.translation: الدارات الديناميكية والدارات الأحادية ... التصريف (transpilation) ... جهاز Backend
examples.suggested: الدوائر الديناميكية والدوائر الموحدة ... التحويل ... جهاز الخلفية
examples.why: Everywhere else the file uses دوائر/موحدة/تحويل/الخلفية. Here, and in [81], the terms switch to دارات/أحادية/التصريف/Backend.

examples.source: The added latency increases decoherence and readout errors
examples.translation: يُزيد التأخير المُضاف من التراجع الكمي وأخطاء القراءة
examples.suggested: يزيد التأخير المضاف من فقدان الترابط الكمومي وأخطاء القراءة
examples.why: التراجع الكمي is not the standard term for decoherence (فقدان الترابط / إزالة الترابط). The same entry also has a gender-agreement error: يبدأ الدائرة should be تبدأ الدائرة.

editor_note: Entry [45] adds something the English does not say. "two qubit gates counts/depth" becomes "عدد بوابات الكيوبتين ودقة/عمق الدائرة", which inserts "دقة" (accuracy/precision). A learner would expect the `metadata` output to report a circuit accuracy or fidelity figure, and it does not. Entry [44] also renders spin as "اللف (spin)", while the rest of the file consistently uses "مغزل/مغازل". Finally, "code" is rendered "رمز" in [9], [27] and [39], where "شيفرة/كود" would read more naturally.

examples.source: `metadata` gives information on the transpilation (two qubit gates counts/depth, gates used, active qubits)
examples.translation: (عدد بوابات الكيوبتين ودقة/عمق الدائرة، البوابات المستخدمة، الكيوبتات النشطة)
examples.suggested: (عدد بوابات الكيوبتين وعمق الدائرة، البوابات المستخدمة، الكيوبتات النشطة)
examples.why: The added word 'دقة' (accuracy) is not in the source. It tells the learner that the metadata includes an accuracy or fidelity figure, which it does not.

examples.source: gives their optimized spin values
examples.translation: ويعطي قيم اللف (spin) المُحسَّنة الخاصة بها
examples.suggested: ويعطي قيم المغازل المُحسَّنة الخاصة بها
examples.why: Everywhere else in the file, spin is rendered 'مغزل/مغازل'. Switching to 'اللف' here breaks that consistency.

examples.source: It provides code to formulate the problem entirely locally
examples.translation: يوفر رمزًا لصياغة المسألة بالكامل محليًا
examples.suggested: يوفر شيفرةً لصياغة المسألة محليًا بالكامل
examples.why: In Arabic, 'رمز' usually means a symbol or token. For source code, 'شيفرة' or 'كود' is the more natural word.

editor_note: I found no semantic drift. The overhead numbers (γ²=100 down to about 6.3, roughly a 16x reduction), the postselection-rate formula and the QED+PEC claims all match the English. Several term choices are wrong or stiff, though. "Unmodeled" noise is rendered as "غير المصممة" ("undesigned") in [25] and [45], and "per-observable" becomes "لكل رصيد" in [30], which means "per balance/credit". "Entangling layers" is rendered as "الطبقات المتشابكة" ("entangled layers") throughout. Postselection is rendered two ways, "الاختيار بعد الانتقاء" and "المنتقاة بعد الاختيار", where the conventional term is "الانتقاء اللاحق". The TREX "rescale factors" become "عوامل إعادة القياس", which reads as "re-measurement factors" in a page where قياس means measurement.

examples.source: to protect against noise that isn't modeled in our learning protocol
examples.translation: للحماية من الضوضاء غير المصممة في بروتوكول التعلم لدينا
examples.suggested: للحماية من الضوضاء غير المُنمذَجة في بروتوكول التعلّم لدينا
examples.why: مصممة means 'designed', not 'modeled'. The same slip appears in [45] as 'مصادر ضوضاء غير مصمَّمة'.

examples.source: shows the per-observable TREX rescale factors
examples.translation: عوامل إعادة القياس (rescale) لـTREX لكل رصيد (observable)
examples.suggested: عوامل إعادة التحجيم لـTREX لكل مرصود (observable)
examples.why: رصيد means a balance or credit, not an observable. إعادة القياس reads as 're-measurement'.

examples.source: Specify the entangling layers in the circuit
examples.translation: تحديد الطبقات المتشابكة في الدائرة
examples.suggested: تحديد طبقات التشابك في الدائرة
examples.why: These layers produce entanglement; they are not themselves entangled. The calque recurs throughout the file.

examples.source: We will run PEC on the postselected noise channel
examples.translation: سنشغّل PEC على قناة الضوضاء المنتقاة بعد الاختيار
examples.suggested: سنشغّل PEC على قناة الضوضاء بعد الانتقاء اللاحق
examples.why: Postselection is rendered two ways in this file, 'الاختيار بعد الانتقاء' and 'المنتقاة بعد الاختيار'. Both are awkward. The conventional term is الانتقاء اللاحق.

examples.source: If both qubits on an edge fail the check, the sample is discarded.
examples.translation: إذا فشل كيوبتان على حافة معينة في اجتياز الفحص، تُهمَل العينة.
examples.suggested: إذا فشل كلا الكيوبتين على الحافة في اجتياز الفحص، تُهمَل العينة.
examples.why: 'كلا الكيوبتين' makes the both-must-fail condition explicit.

editor_note: The main mistake is that "classically" is translated as تصنيفيًا ("by classification") instead of كلاسيكيًا. In [28] this hides the central point of PNA: the inverse noise is applied on a classical computer instead of being sampled on the QPU. A learner could read it as some kind of classification of the observable. The same error appears in [58], where "classical bookkeeping" becomes المحاسبة التصنيفية. There are also smaller issues: "conjugate two operators" becomes توليف ("compose") in [121], and "evolved generator" becomes the calque المولد المتطور in [116]. Several core terms also switch within the file: noise ضجيج/ضوضاء, observable مُلاحَظ/المرصودة/المرصود, twirling التواء/لفّ, post-selection الانتقاء البعدي/الاختيار اللاحق, primitive الأساسي/الأداة الأولية/بدائية.

examples.source: we apply it classically to the measured observable using Pauli propagation
examples.translation: نطبقها تصنيفيًا على المُلاحَظ المقيس باستخدام نشر باولي
examples.suggested: نطبقها كلاسيكيًا (على حاسوب تقليدي) على المُلاحَظ المقيس باستخدام نشر باولي
examples.why: تصنيفيًا means 'by classification', not 'classically'. It hides the key contrast between sampling on the QPU and classical post-processing, which is what defines PNA.

examples.source: this only validates the classical bookkeeping against noise you injected yourself
examples.translation: هذا يتحقق فقط من المحاسبة التصنيفية مقابل الضجيج الذي أدخلته أنت بنفسك
examples.suggested: هذا يتحقق فقط من الحسابات الكلاسيكية مقابل الضجيج الذي أدخلته بنفسك
examples.why: The same classical→classification mistranslation again.

examples.source: a greedy method to approximately conjugate two operators in the Pauli basis
examples.translation: طريقة جشعة لتوليف مؤثرين تقريبيًا في أساس باولي
examples.suggested: طريقة جشعة لإجراء الترافق (conjugation) بين مؤثرين تقريبيًا في أساس باولي
examples.why: توليف means combining or composing, not operator conjugation, so the reader learns the wrong operation.

examples.source: propagating inverse noise channels into the observable
examples.translation: نشر قنوات الضوضاء المعكوسة في المرصود
examples.suggested: نشر قنوات الضجيج المعكوسة في المُلاحَظ
examples.why: The rest of the file uses ضجيج and مُلاحَظ. Here (and in [6] and [153]) the terms switch to ضوضاء and المرصود.

examples.source: The `Executor` primitive samples the twirled, randomized circuits
examples.translation: تأخذ الأداة الأولية `Executor` عينات من الدارات الملفوفة والعشوائية
examples.suggested: يأخذ الأساسي `Executor` عينات من الدارات الملفوفة والعشوائية
examples.why: 'primitive' is translated three ways (الأساسي in [0]/[12], الأداة الأولية here, بدائية in [155]). Twirling is also split between التواء ([7], [13]) and لفّ.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, and the caveats survive: the 23.7 kcal/mol gap in [75] and the removed opposite-spin interactions in [76] are both there. The problems are inconsistent terms. "Diagonalization" is التقطير in [10]/[15] but التحليل القطري in [81]/[82]. "Primitives" is مبدئيات in [12] but العناصر الأساسية in [33]/[59]/[63]. "Quantum" switches between الكمومية and الكمية. Transpilation appears three ways: تحويل in [14], left in English in [24], and تصريف in [57], which also translates "compilation" in [24]. There are also small grammar and calque slips in [8], [9] and [61].

examples.source: SQD (Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization)
examples.translation: التقطير الكمومي القائم على العينات
examples.suggested: التحليل القطري الكمي القائم على العينات
examples.why: Entries [81] and [82] use التحليل القطري. التقطير is a real term for diagonalization, but a learner may read it as 'distillation', and the two renderings of one method name are inconsistent.

examples.source: Circuit compilation, optimization, and transpilation remain in the application layer
examples.translation: يبقى تصريف الدارات (compilation) وتحسينها و transpilation ضمن طبقة التطبيق
examples.suggested: يبقى تصريف الدارات وتحسينها وتحويلها (transpilation) ضمن طبقة التطبيق
examples.why: Here transpilation is left in English, [57] renders transpile as تصريف (the same word used for compilation here), and [14] uses تحويل. That blurs the line between compilation and transpilation.

examples.source: Qiskit primitives (Sampler and Estimator)
examples.translation: مبدئيات Qiskit
examples.suggested: العناصر الأساسية (primitives) في Qiskit
examples.why: This entry uses مبدئيات, while [33], [59] and [63] use العناصر الأساسية for the same term.

examples.source: so that failures after acquisition still release a notebook-owned session
examples.translation: بحيث تظل الأعطال التي تحدث بعد الحصول على المورد تُحرر الجلسة المملوكة لدفتر الملاحظات
examples.suggested: بحيث تُحرَّر الجلسة التابعة لدفتر الملاحظات حتى لو حدث عطل بعد الحصول على المورد
examples.why: This is a calque that makes the failures the thing that releases the session. The rewording is clearer.

examples.source: How HPC schedulers (Slurm) inject quantum resources
examples.translation: كيفية تحقن مجدولات HPC
examples.suggested: كيف تحقن مجدولات HPC
examples.why: Ungrammatical: كيفية is a noun and cannot be followed directly by a verb. A similar agreement slip is in [8] (غلافي ... عالي المستوى should be عاليَي المستوى).

editor_note: Two sentences change the technical meaning. In [61], DD "averaging out" environmental interactions becomes "يُعيّر" ("calibrates"), which misdescribes how dynamical decoupling works. In [74], "circuit depth on the order of a billion" becomes "عمق دائرة يبلغ مليار بوابة": the "on the order of" hedge is gone and depth is turned into a gate count. Smaller problems: "unitary" in [22] is rendered as "أحادية الاتجاه" ("unidirectional"), and only the English gloss saves it. "transpiled" becomes "ترجمناها" in [61] but "تحويل" elsewhere, and "report the circuit depth" becomes "نُرسل" ("send") in [50]. Terms change halfway through the file: كيوبت turns into قيوبت, كمي into كمومي, شور into Shor, and عتاد into أجهزة. "demonstrated" is rendered as "أثبت" ("proved"), and [71] has a gender-agreement error ("حلّل تجربة").

examples.source: effectively averaging out unwanted environmental interactions and decoherence
examples.translation: مما يُعيّر التفاعلات البيئية غير المرغوبة وظاهرة decoherence بصورة فعّالة
examples.suggested: مما يُلغي فعلياً أثر التفاعلات البيئية غير المرغوبة وفقدان الترابط (decoherence) عبر حساب متوسطها
examples.why: 'يُعيّر' means 'calibrates', not 'averages out'. A learner would come away with the wrong idea of what dynamical decoupling does.

examples.source: a circuit depth on the order of a billion
examples.translation: وعمق دائرة يبلغ مليار بوابة
examples.suggested: وعمق دائرة من رتبة المليار
examples.why: The order-of-magnitude hedge is dropped, and circuit depth (layers) is presented as a count of gates. Both change what the source claims.

examples.source: along with a unitary quantum circuit
examples.translation: دائرة كمية أحادية الاتجاه (unitary)
examples.suggested: دائرة كمية أحادية (unitary)
examples.why: 'أحادية الاتجاه' means 'unidirectional', not 'unitary'. Everywhere else the file correctly uses 'أحادية' on its own.

examples.source: we transpile the circuit ... and report the circuit depth and gate counts
examples.translation: نُحوّل الدائرة ... ونُرسل عمق الدائرة وأعداد البوابات
examples.suggested: ونعرض عمق الدائرة وأعداد البوابات
examples.why: 'نُرسل' means 'send'. The source means 'report' or 'display'.

examples.source: the order finding circuit that we previously transpiled
examples.translation: دائرة إيجاد الرتبة التي ترجمناها سابقاً
examples.suggested: التي حوّلناها (transpile) سابقاً
examples.why: The file uses 'تحويل' for transpile in [14] and [50]. 'ترجمناها' means 'translated', so it is inconsistent and misleading. The same stretch also switches from كيوبت to قيوبت and from كمي to كمومي.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout and I found nothing that would mislead a learner, but the page reads as if two different translators wrote it. From entry [53] on, the terms change. "Trotter" becomes "تروتر", "ansatz" becomes "أنساتز", "ground state" goes from "حالة الأساس" to "الحالة الأرضية", the neutron "kick" goes from "ضربة" to "ركلة", "Backend" becomes "الخلفية", and "two-spinon continuum" goes from "متصل السبينونين الثنائي" to "متصل الاثنين-سبينون". "Fidelity" appears as "إخلاص" in the first half but as "دقة" (accuracy) in [57]. "Observables" in [79] is rendered "الملاحظات" (notes/observations), which is the wrong domain term. There are also two smaller slips: "hardware transpilation" in [46] becomes "ترجمة العتاد", and in [56] the instruction "Build ..." turns into the noun "بناء" instead of an imperative.

examples.source: Expect a lower ground-state fidelity than the 10-site run
examples.translation: توقع دقة حالة أرضية أقل من التشغيل ذي 10 مواقع
examples.suggested: توقع إخلاص حالة أساس أقل من التشغيل ذي 10 مواقع
examples.why: Fidelity is 'إخلاص' elsewhere in the file (e.g. [10], [44]). 'دقة' means accuracy, and 'الحالة الأرضية' does not match the earlier 'حالة الأساس'.

examples.source: a different chain Hamiltonian, initial state, or set of observables
examples.translation: أو مجموعة مختلفة من الملاحظات
examples.suggested: أو مجموعة مختلفة من المرصودات (observables)
examples.why: 'الملاحظات' means notes or observations, not quantum observables. Also, 'هاميلتونيان' here does not match 'هاملتوني' used earlier.

examples.source: bake in the $\pi/2$ $Z$ neutron kick
examples.translation: ثم دمج ركلة النيوترون
examples.suggested: ثم أدمج ضربة النيوترون
examples.why: 'kick' was 'ضربة' in [20], [44] and [47] but is 'ركلة' here. The imperatives also become verbal nouns (بناء/دمج), unlike the matching small-scale step [44].

examples.source: the two-spinon continuum is far better resolved
examples.translation: يصبح متصل الاثنين-سبينون محلولاً بشكل أفضل بكثير
examples.suggested: يصبح متصل السبينونين أوضح تمييزًا بكثير
examples.why: This does not match 'متصل السبينونين الثنائي' in [12], [17] and [49]. 'الاثنين-سبينون' is an awkward calque, and 'محلولاً' reads as 'solved' rather than spectrally resolved.

examples.source: AQC compression, and hardware transpilation
examples.translation: وضغط AQC، وترجمة العتاد (transpilation)
examples.suggested: وضغط AQC، والتحويل (transpilation) للعتاد
examples.why: 'ترجمة العتاد' reads as 'translating the hardware'. What is meant is transpiling circuits for the hardware.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The gate explanations (X changes p to 1-p; S/Z/S-dagger phase shifts), the CNOT control logic and the Bell/GHZ tasks all match the English. The first half consistently uses كمي for "quantum", but from [77] on it switches to كمومي, and "circuit" appears as دائرة, دارة and bare Circuit. Several sentences have grammar or agreement errors: "غير أن لاحظ" in [51], "تكون الطور" in [52], "الدائرة الكمي المقابل" in [60] and "الـ Qiskit primitives اثنتين" in [105]. Also, "Map" in [97] is rendered as the noun الخريطة ("the map") rather than the action التعيين, and the vague source line "allow for more QPU time" in [116] became تتيح المزيد من وقت QPU, which suggests you are granted extra time rather than that these options use more of it.

examples.source: However, note also that the size of the circles at the two points is smaller
examples.translation: غير أن لاحظ أيضاً أن حجم الدوائر عند النقطتين أصغر
examples.suggested: لكن لاحظ أيضاً أن حجم الدوائر عند النقطتين أصغر
examples.why: غير أن must be followed by a noun clause, not an imperative. As written, the sentence is ungrammatical.

examples.source: the code that creates the corresponding quantum circuit in Qiskit
examples.translation: الكود الذي ينشئ الدائرة الكمي المقابل في Qiskit
examples.suggested: الكود الذي ينشئ الدائرة الكمية المقابلة في Qiskit
examples.why: Gender agreement error: دائرة is feminine, but its adjectives are masculine.

examples.source: solve 4 quantum state quizzes
examples.translation: حل 4 اختبارات للحالة الكمومية
examples.suggested: حل 4 اختبارات للحالة الكمية
examples.why: Entries [5]-[63] use كمي, then from here on the file switches to كمومي (also in [79], [93], [94]). The file should pick one.

examples.source: **Map** problem to quantum circuits and operators
examples.translation: **الخريطة**: تعيين المشكلة إلى Circuits كمومية ومؤثرات
examples.suggested: **التعيين**: تعيين المشكلة إلى دوائر كمية ومؤثرات
examples.why: 'Map' here is the step's action (mapping), not the noun 'a map'. The other steps use action nouns (التحسين, التنفيذ).

examples.source: (Note) These options allow for more QPU time.
examples.translation: (ملاحظة) تتيح هذه الخيارات المزيد من وقت QPU.
examples.suggested: (ملاحظة) تستهلك هذه الخيارات مزيداً من وقت QPU.
examples.why: The intent is that error-mitigation options cost more QPU time. تتيح reads as if the user gets extra QPU time.

editor_note: The definition of universality is mistranslated: in [9], "arbitrary unitary operations" becomes "عمليات أحادية عشوائية", which means "random" unitaries, so a learner is told something false about what a universal gate set does. [127] shows the correct word, اعتباطية. In [36], T₂ dephasing and "relative phase coherence" become "الإزالة المرحلية / التماسك المرحلي النسبي". مرحلي means "stage-wise", not "phase" (طوري), even though [18] correctly used تلاشي الطور. [68] renders feed-forward control as "التحكم التلقائي" (automatic control), which is a different concept. Smaller issues: [4] "سنُختبر" is voweled as a passive ("we will be tested"); [42] drops "arbitrary" from the single-qubit rotations; teleportation appears as both النقل الكمومي and "teleportation" left in English; and the file mixes كمي/كمومي, ضوضاء/ضجيج, دائرة/Circuit and ديفينشنزو/DiVincenzo.

examples.source: A universal set of quantum gates (able to perform arbitrary unitary operations).
examples.translation: مجموعة شاملة من Gates الكمية (قادرة على تنفيذ عمليات أحادية عشوائية).
examples.suggested: مجموعة شاملة من البوابات الكمومية (قادرة على تنفيذ أي عملية أحادية (unitary) اعتباطية).
examples.why: عشوائية means 'random'. Universality means any chosen unitary can be built, not random ones, so this teaches a false idea of the criterion.

examples.source: T₂ time (dephasing time, how quickly relative phase coherence is lost)
examples.translation: زمن T₂ (زمن الإزالة المرحلية، أي مدى سرعة فقدان التماسك المرحلي النسبي)
examples.suggested: زمن T₂ (زمن فقدان الطور، أي مدى سرعة فقدان تماسك الطور النسبي)
examples.why: مرحلي means 'stage/phase of a process', not quantum phase (طور). The T₂ concept becomes unidentifiable, and it contradicts تلاشي الطور in [18].

examples.source: a practical grasp of measurement, entanglement, and feed-forward control in action
examples.translation: للقياس والتشابك والتحكم التلقائي في العمل
examples.suggested: للقياس والتشابك والتحكم الأمامي (feed-forward) المشروط بنتائج القياس عمليًا
examples.why: 'Automatic control' is not feed-forward, which means applying gates conditioned on mid-circuit classical results. 'في العمل' is also a calque of 'in action'.

examples.source: In this notebook, we will experience each DiVincenzo criterion
examples.translation: في هذا الدفتر، سنُختبر كل معيار
examples.suggested: في هذا الدفتر، سنختبر كل معيار
examples.why: The damma makes the verb passive ('we will be tested'), which reverses who does the experiencing.
